review_candidates.description: About The Company Rubicon Consulting is a premier talent management consultancy dedicated to helping organizations optimize their business performance and gain a competitive edge through strategic human resource solutions. With a proven track record of connecting top-tier talent with innovative companies, Rubicon Consulting specializes in sourcing, screening, and placing highly skilled professionals across various industries. Our commitment to excellence and personalized approach ensures that our clients receive tailored staffing solutions that meet their unique needs. We pride ourselves on fostering long-term relationships with both clients and candidates, emphasizing quality, integrity, and professionalism in every engagement. About The Role We are currently seeking a highly skilled Voice Services Developer to join our dynamic team on a 4+ year contract based in Suffolk. This role is pivotal in building, maintaining, and optimizing next-generation communication platforms that leverage both traditional telecommunication protocols and modern cloud-based AI technologies. As a Voice Services Developer, you will serve as a bridge between legacy telephony systems and cutting-edge cloud solutions, ensuring seamless integration and high-performance voice services. Your expertise will contribute to the development of stable SIP services, management of open-source media engines, and the integration of advanced Speech AI technologies across multi-cloud environments. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive professional eager to work on innovative communication solutions within a collaborative and forward-thinking organization. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background with the following qualifications: Professional experience with Java programming, including multi-threading and network programming. In-depth knowledge of Java applications utilizing JAIN SLEE framework and SIP Servlet frameworks. Hands-on experience configuring and scripting with telephony engines such as FreeSWITCH or Asterisk. Solid understanding of voice protocols including SIP, RTP/RTCP, and SDP. Experience integrating cloud speech APIs such as AWS Transcribe/Polly, Azure Speech, or Google Cloud Speech-to-Text. Proficiency in deploying and managing applications across multi-cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Proficiency with network analysis tools like Wireshark or sngrep for VoIP troubleshooting. Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes is preferred. Understanding of WebRTC and telephony security standards including TLS and SRTP is advantageous. Responsibilities The successful candidate will be responsible for the following key duties: SIP Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance SIP-based voice services utilizing frameworks such as JAIN SLEE and SIP Servlets to ensure reliable communication channels. Media Server Administration: Configure, manage, and scale open-source media engines like FreeSWITCH or Asterisk to support robust voice communication solutions. Speech AI Integration: Implement and optimize Speech-to-Text (STT), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) workflows to enhance voice interactions and automate responses. Cloud Operations: Deploy, monitor, and optimize voice applications across multiple cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, ensuring scalability and resilience. Troubleshooting and Diagnostics: Utilize network analysis tools such as Wireshark or sngrep to diagnose and resolve issues related to audio quality, call drops, and latency to maintain high service quality. Team Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with senior architects, DevOps teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to roll out scalable conversational AI bots and voice solutions. Documentation and Compliance: Maintain comprehensive documentation of development processes, configurations, and troubleshooting procedures to ensure compliance and facilitate knowledge sharing. Benefits Rubicon Consulting offers a competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well-being and professional growth. This includes comprehensive health insurance, paid time off, and opportunities for continuous learning and development. Employees will have the chance to work on innovative projects with cutting-edge technologies, contributing to the evolution of communication platforms. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diversity, creativity, and initiative. Additionally, our flexible work arrangements and supportive management team ensure a positive and engaging workplace experience. Equal Opportunity Rubicon Consulting is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe in creating a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve and encourages innovation through varied perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer based in United Kingdom. This is a senior backend engineering role focused on building the data infrastructure behind a large-scale enterprise process platform. You will design and evolve storage, query, and data-processing capabilities across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. Your work will directly influence how process data is stored, retained, queried, monitored, and exposed to customers. You will own substantial engineering initiatives from solution design through delivery, working closely with Product, QA, Support, and SRE. The environment is highly distributed and remote-first, with a strong emphasis on technical ownership, collaboration, and production excellence. You will also contribute to challenging problems around performance, scalability, data pipelines, and reliable operation at scale. The role offers the opportunity to shape a critical data layer while contributing to an increasingly AI-driven enterprise software platform. Accountabilities Design, build, maintain, and improve backend services responsible for storing and serving process data at enterprise scale. Develop solutions across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, balancing correctness, performance, availability, scalability, and maintainability. Own engineering initiatives from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, coordination, delivery, and production rollout. Partner closely with Product Management and cross-functional engineering teams to translate business and customer requirements into actionable technical solutions. Evolve data processing, retention, storage, and exposure capabilities to meet changing customer and product requirements. Improve the performance and scalability of secondary storage systems as usage and data volumes grow. Build internal tooling and operational capabilities that make the data layer easier to understand, troubleshoot, monitor, and operate safely in production. Investigate production data issues, including slow queries, execution plans, indexing problems, and other performance bottlenecks, and drive them through root-cause analysis and resolution. Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, collaborating with Support and Site Reliability Engineering teams to resolve production incidents. Use production learnings and operational insights to continuously improve the reliability, performance, and usability of the data layer. Provide and receive clear, constructive feedback through code reviews and technical collaboration. Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices and architecture within a remote-first, cross-functional environment. Requirements 7+ years of professional experience as a backend software engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores. Deep hands-on experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or MSSQL. Strong practical experience with Elasticsearch and/or OpenSearch, including indexing, query performance, and data modeling trade-offs. Proven ability to investigate slow queries, analyze execution plans and index usage, and identify root causes of production data and performance issues. Demonstrated experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives lasting three months or longer, covering solution design, planning, cross-team coordination, and predictable delivery. Strong understanding of backend architecture, data storage, query systems, and production-scale engineering. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a distributed and remote-first environment. Ability to translate product requirements into clear technical plans and actionable engineering work. Comfortable working independently while maintaining strong alignment with Product, Engineering, Support, and SRE stakeholders. Willingness and ability to use the product directly to understand customer workflows and technical requirements. Experience with workflow automation or process orchestration software is a plus. Experience working across both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch is advantageous. Experience building or maintaining CI pipelines is beneficial. Familiarity with database migration tools such as Liquibase or Flyway and with schema evolution in live production systems is a plus. Benefits Fully remote position with flexibility to work from anywhere within the eligible EMEA region. Competitive, location-based compensation designed around local market conditions. Equity opportunities through a Virtual Stock Option Plan where applicable. Home office budget and support for coworking spaces. Flexible time off to support sustainable work and wellbeing. Locally tailored healthcare benefits where applicable. Access to global mental wellbeing support. Flexible lifestyle spending benefits covering areas such as fitness, family care, personal interests, experiences, and financial wellbeing. Retirement and pension plans, often including company contributions, depending on location. Life and disability insurance where applicable. Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-directed professional development, including courses, certifications, and books. Opportunities to connect with colleagues through annual company kickoffs, team offsites, local gatherings, and connection budgets. Inclusive, remote-first working environment with strong emphasis on collaboration, autonomy, and professional growth. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. review_candidates.title: Junior Software Engineer – Early Career (Strong Problem solving & Coding Focus) - 100% Remote within Spain
review_candidates.description: Welcome to the good side of tech 👋 You might know us as ZnanyLekarz in Poland or Doctoralia in Spain. Globally, we are Docplanner. We build technology that helps people live longer, healthier lives. Our products connect patients with doctors, power clinical workflows, and support healthcare systems used by millions of people every month. Engineering at Docplanner is about building reliable, scalable systems with real human impact. What we ship affects patients, doctors, and clinics in everyday, high-stakes situations - which means quality, judgment, and long-term thinking matter. In 2026, we are accelerating delivery across multiple product areas by changing how we build - leveraging AI-assisted development to increase engineering effectiveness and raise the bar on how we design, ship, and evolve systems. And why should you join us? Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs. We want to help people live longer, healthier lives, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self. You can decide to work fully remote, or work hybrid with our offices located in Barcelona or Warsaw. This will be dependent on the final team allocation. Our challenges Our Engineers may join teams working on these areas and challenges: Marketplace & Search Build the next-generation marketplace system by owning the end-to-end journey from agentic discovery to rebooking. You’ll leverage AI search and AI onboarding funnels to unlock new demand and transform one-off bookings into continuous care loops. Practice Management Systems (PMS) Build the next generation of software to help doctors globally. Unify the current fragmented reality and leverage AI to reinvent the way to help doctors focus on what matters most: treating the patient. AI-powered Clinical Tools (Noa Medic) Design AI-native clinical workflows that move beyond simple scribing to replace end-to-end administrative tasks. You'll build deep PMS/EHR embeddings that become an indispensable daily habit for medical professionals. Patient & Data Integrations (Noa Patient) Move beyond the booking button to build a proactive healthcare partner. You'll create the smart connections that blend someone's medical past with their live health data, crafting an AI experience that actually keeps patients coming back. Turn raw data into advice people can use, making Docplanner the one health app they can't live without. Internally, these challenges map to some of our most ambitious and high-impact initiatives. How We Build Software We build systems that matter and we optimize for clarity, speed, and long-term maintainability. Small autonomous teams that own real product surfaces end-to-end High trust and high ownership from day one Production impact early - even as a junior engineer AI-assisted development as a default workflow Strong engineering culture focused on simplicity, correctness, and measurable outcomes We prefer solving problems well over adding unnecessary complexity. Good ideas win regardless of tenure or hierarchy. What We Value Strong problem solving ability. The ability to break down complex systems and find elegant solutions. Builder mindset. You like creating things that people use. Intellectual curiosity. You enjoy understanding how systems really work. Ownership. You treat problems as yours until they are solved. Pragmatism. You know when to optimize and when to ship. We value signals over credentials. Competition programming, open-source work, research, side projects or anything else that shows how you think. Technical Environment Our stack evolves continuously, but currently includes technologies such as: Backend: Node.js, TypeScript Frontend: React, TypeScript Mobile: React Native Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform Developer tooling: modern CI/CD, observability AI-assisted coding environments built to scale (guardrails, rules, skills, subagents, spec-driven development) We invest heavily in developer productivity and continuously improve how we design and ship systems. Collaboration Model Open source internal culture - contribute across different services and teams Maintainer guidance rather than gatekeeping from senior developers Cross-functional ownership of features from conception to deployment Living documentation shared across all team members Why Junior Devs Love It Here Some reasons engineers choose to stay at Docplanner: Real scale. Millions of users and thousands of healthcare providers across multiple countries. Interesting problems. Distributed systems, search relevance, AI-assisted workflows, complex integrations. Exceptional teammates. Work with talented people across disciplines who raise the bar for everyone. Fast learning curve. You will work on real production systems very early. Meaningful mission. Helping people live longer, healthier lives. Required Qualifications Strong foundations in computer science Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, complexity, and core software engineering principles. Ability to build real software Comfortable working across the stack to design, implement, and ship features that solve real user problems. Strong problem-solving skills You enjoy breaking down complex problems and finding simple, effective solutions. Builder mindset You like turning ideas into working products and taking ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. Curiosity about users and problems You’re comfortable talking to users, understanding their needs, and iterating on solutions. High learning velocity You pick up new technologies, tools, and domains quickly and continuously improve your craft. AI-first engineering mindset You actively experiment with AI coding tools, agents, and new workflows, and are excited about reinventing how software is built. Preferred Academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or another rigorous technical discipline. Competitive programming experience Participation in ICPC, Google Code Jam, national olympiads, Codeforces, or similar competitions. Evidence of building things Side projects, startups, open-source contributions, hackathons, or shipped products. Exposure to modern engineering workflows Experience working with collaborative development, continuous delivery, strong observability, and AI-assisted development practices. Benefits Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings; True flexibility and work-life balance Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona; Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly); Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier); 23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays; Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate). Health comes first Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental); Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Wellhub. Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling. Keep growing with us Free English classes.
